title: leuzea rhapontica subsp. heleniifolia
intro: Leuzea rhapontica subsp. heleniifolia, commonly known as Krestin, is a subspecies of Leuzea rhapontica, a perennial plant native to Central Asia. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as improved sleep quality, reduced fatigue, and enhanced mental performance. The therapeutic actions of Krestin include adaptogenic and nootropic effects, which help the body adapt to stress and promote cognitive function. The plant's bioactive constituents include glycosides, flavonoids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
